sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: still-effect sprite sheet for a Phaser Maya fantasy game. Requested image model gpt-image-2.5 Flare. References: Image 1 is the FX pixel-art style reference (bright cores, crisp stepped pixels); Image 2 is the Mesoamerican material/style reference only. Generate ORIGINAL sprites, not copies. One 2048x2048 image, exactly 4x4 equal cells, one standalone still object centered per 512x512 cell, each with at least 64px completely transparent padding. All background genuinely transparent. No frame sequences, no characters, no text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no watermark. Crisp detailed pixel-art, small bright cores, limited palettes, stepped angular highlights, no realistic smooth airbrushing. Do NOT include icon frames from Image 2. Effects must be separate and never touch adjacent cells. All horizontal projectiles point RIGHT. Cells in strict reading order:
1. Atlatl Volley MAIN: one slim turquoise dart, red-feather fletching, bright turquoise stone point, #3fd0d0 / #d9413a.
2. Atlatl Volley ACCENT: compact turquoise muzzle sparkle with a small burst of red feathers.
3. Featherstorm MAIN: upright tornado funnel made of dark red and ivory feathers, #a02a2a / #f4f0e6, clearly tapered twisting silhouette.
4. Featherstorm ACCENT: one curved scattering fan of dark red and white feather debris, not a funnel.
5. Serpent Path MAIN: elongated sinuous jade serpent pointing right with luminous green head and one long wavy pale tail, #3de08f / #c8ffd8.
6. Serpent Path ACCENT: long wavy translucent green trail ribbon with tiny scale sparkles, no serpent head.
7. Windstep MAIN: three tapering cyan horizontal speed streaks with a compact wind swirl at the leading tip, #6ad0ff / #e8fbff.
8. Windstep ACCENT: one wispy translucent white-cyan wind ribbon, curled and fading, horizontal composition.
9. Quetzal Flip MAIN: a semicircular feather-coloured arc afterimage, alternate red and jade highlights, #d9413a / #3de08f.
10. Quetzal Flip ACCENT: compact take-off spray of red and green quetzal feathers, no body or person.
11. Hunter Snare MAIN: one brown unfurled woven rope net, open diamond mesh, glowing tan knots, #a8743a / #3b2a1a.
12. Hunter Snare ACCENT: one circular sticky grass ground decal with short loose rope strands, dark green-brown, top-down view.
13. Eagle Eye MAIN: one luminous golden eagle eye surrounded by a thin shrinking-ring motif, #ffd45a, NO bird head.
14. Eagle Eye ACCENT: one extremely thin horizontal gold-white energy beam ending in a sharp white star flash, #ffd45a / #ffffff.
15. Sun Dart MAIN: one gold solar dart pointing right, orange sun-spark comet trail, #ffd45a / #ff8a1f, clearly distinct from turquoise dart.
16. Sun Dart ACCENT: one orange-gold angular sunburst with a small kinked ricochet ray, not the straight Eagle Eye beam.
All subjects fully visible with generous transparent margins, no cut-off sparks.
CRITICAL LAYOUT CORRECTION: the prior sheet crowded objects across cell borders. Shrink EVERY object to a maximum bounding box of 300x300 within its 512x512 cell (about 58% of cell width/height). Center each object exactly at its cell centre, leaving at least 106px transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides of each cell. No sprite or glow or spark touches any cell edge or the outside canvas. Long darts/serpents/beams must be smaller and FULLY visible, not clipped, each within 300px width. Empty background should occupy at least half this sheet. Sixteen clearly separated standalone sprites. Do not draw lines or frames to mark the grid.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL still-effect sprite sheet for Kukul, a Maya fantasy Phaser game. Requested gpt-image-2.5 Flare. Image 1 is the bright-core crisp stepped pixel-art FX style reference. Image 2 is the Mesoamerican fantasy material reference ONLY; do not draw icon frames. One square 2048x2048 image, exactly 4x4 equal cells, one object per cell. TRUE transparent background. Very important: each subject, glow and sparks fits within the central 300x300 of its 512x512 cell, leaving at least 106px empty transparent margin all sides. Sixteen small separated centred sprites; over half the canvas empty. Crisp detailed pixel edges, limited palettes with luminous cores, not smooth photo painting. No characters, no letters, no numbers, no borders, no captions, no watermark, no frame sequences. Horizontal projectiles and beams point RIGHT. Cells strictly reading order:
1. Storm Nest MAIN: one compact brown woven feather nest with three ivory eggs and a small blue gale curling above, #7fb8ff / #a8743a, no bird.
2. Storm Nest ACCENT: three separate parallel thin pale-blue dart streaks forming one tight fan.
3. Plume Guard MAIN: ONE long jade quetzal feather with a red base and green luminous edge, #3de08f / #d9413a; singular so code orbits three copies.
4. Plume Guard ACCENT: compact green feather-pop flash and tiny red quill flecks.
5. Cacao Bomb MAIN: one brown clay cacao pot with a small brightly lit fuse and a subtle ground shadow, #a85a2a / #ffb347.
6. Cacao Bomb ACCENT: brown-orange explosive burst with distinct cacao-bean shrapnel, no pot.
7. Forked Flight MAIN: one slim turquoise dart pointing right with a simple white curved tail, #3fd0d0 / #ffffff; NO red feathers (distinct from Atlatl Volley).
8. Forked Flight ACCENT: one bright white-turquoise three-pronged fork flash, with three curved diverging trails.
9. Gale Ring MAIN: thin translucent white-blue ring of wind carrying a few tiny green leaves, #cfeaff / #6ad0ff; no dense vortex.
10. Gale Ring ACCENT: a small outward-scattering leaf-debris puff edged cyan, distinct from ring.
11. Hunters Trance MAIN: ONLY two small luminous golden eye-shaped light marks, no head, no face, no human, transparent around them.
12. Hunters Trance ACCENT: one faint gold crosshair reticle with an open centre and four tiny orbit sparks.
13. Skyfall MAIN: one heavy brown-black dart pointing RIGHT with a long red-brown smoke trail, #d9413a / #3b2a1a, distinct chunky silhouette.
14. Skyfall ACCENT: one thin RED telegraph circle with a compact brown dust puff at its centre, top-down, no numbers.
15. Kukulkans Breath MAIN: one GREEN TURQUOISE GOLD luminous scaled beam, horizontal pointing right, flowing quetzal scale texture, #3de08f / #ffd45a, no head.
16. Kukulkans Breath ACCENT: one jade feathered serpent HEAD ONLY facing right with gold fangs, open mouth at origin, no body.
Make every full object cleanly contained in its cell. No cropped feathers, heads, rays or smoke; no merging between cells.

Image 1 is the bright-core stepped pixel-edge FX reference. Image 2 is materials/style only, NO icon frames. One 2048x2048 square canvas with a 4x4 equal-cell grid layout. Only the FIRST EIGHT cells (top TWO rows, four per row) contain sprites; bottom eight cells remain COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT. One isolated compact object per cell, centered, maximum 300x300 inside 512x512 cell, at least 106px transparent padding each side. Transparent background, no visible grid, no borders, no text, no numbers, no labels, no characters, no watermark, no frame sequences. Strongly different silhouettes and palette, crisp pixel-art luminous cores; no smooth photoreal painting. Cells in strict reading order:
TOP ROW cell 1. Sharpened Flint: brilliant WHITE pinpoint glint on ONE tiny sharp pale flint dart tip, angular narrow sparkle, not a full arrow.
TOP ROW cell 2. Venomous Darts: three GREEN poisonous droplets hanging and dripping, acid-green bright cores and darker green edges, no arrow.
TOP ROW cell 3. Full Quiver: one small BROWN quiver filled with SIX red-feather turquoise darts, warm gold flashing rim, no written 6.
TOP ROW cell 4. Hunters Focus: small RED crosshair with FIVE tiny RED targeting pips spaced above it, open transparent centre, no eye, distinct from a full reticle ring.
SECOND ROW cell 1. Fleet Hunter: one thin WHITE-CYAN wind swirl curling around a tiny turquoise dart, horizontal; bright white core, not green.
SECOND ROW cell 2. Jungle Instinct: a GREEN leaf burst around a pale translucent mist afterimage, NO human body or face, use a ghostly wind silhouette only.
SECOND ROW cell 3. Trophy Hunter: small GOLD feather burst with three gold quills and amber celebratory sparks, warm gold only, no skull or text.
SECOND ROW cell 4. Steady Aim: one very THIN JADE reticle ring with four white ticks and a small pinpoint centre, transparent open centre, no eye, no solid disc.
Bottom TWO rows fully transparent. Exactly eight sprites, not duplicates. Fully visible, centred, ample padding. Do not add extra objects.
